mapper.select: /* selectBuyerWmGrWarehousingTotPopList */ SELECT S.GR_STATUS , S.PO_CREATE_DATE , S.PO_NO , S.GR_NO , S.BUYER_ITEM_NO , S.REF_PR_NO , S.DESCRIPTION , S.SPECIFICATION , S.UNIT_PRICE , S.ITEM_AMT , S.UNIT_MEASURE , S.PO_ITEM_QTY , S.GR_ITEM_QTY , S.GR_QTY , S.GR_DATE , S.PO_CREATOR , DECODE(( SELECT AGENT_OPEN_FLAG FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{buyer}),'N', '코리아이플랫폼(주)', S.AGENT_NAME) AS AGENT_NAME , S.REQ_DEPT_NAME , S.GR_SEQ , S.PO_SEQ , S.INV_NO , S.INV_SEQ , S.IV_EXIST , S.BUYER , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{buyer}) AS BUYER_NAME , S.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , S.CONTRACT_NO , S.CONTRACT_SEQ , S.PR_NO , S.AGENT , S.CHANGE_USER_DEPT , DECODE(( SELECT AGENT_OPEN_FLAG FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{buyer}), 'N', 'KRKORE0001', S.AGENT) AS AGENT_CODE , S.CLOSE_FLAG , S.AR_BILL_FLAG , S.AP_BILL_FLAG , S.REF_PR_NO_TEXT , ( SELECT CARD_USE_FLAG FROM ICOMPRHD PRHD WHERE S.BUYER = PRHD.BUYER AND S.PR_NO = PRHD.PR_NO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS CARD_USE_FLAG , ( SELECT CARD_CONFIRM_NO FROM ICOMPRHD PRHD WHERE S.BUYER = PRHD.BUYER AND S.PR_NO = PRHD.PR_NO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS CARD_CONFIRM_NO , S.PX_NO , S.CATEG_ID , S.BUDGET_DEPT , S.BUDGET_DEPT_NAME , S.ACCOUNT_TYPE , S.ACCOUNT_NAME , S.ADD_USER_NAME , S.CATEG_NAME , S.SO_CA_GUBUN , S.RECV_FLAG , S.CLSD_FLAG , S.PCO_REF_PR_NO , S.PCO_LEGACY_PO_NO , S.PR_CHANGE_DATE , S.GR_ADD_USER_ID , S.GR_ADD_USER_NAME FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT DECODE(GR.CLOSE_FLAG, 'Y', '마감완료', DECODE((NVL(PO.ITEM_QTY,0)-NVL(PO.GR_QTY,0)), 0, '입고완료', '부분입고')) AS GR_STATUS , PH.PO_CREATE_DATE , PO.PO_NO , GR.GR_NO , PO.BUYER_ITEM_NO , PO.REF_PR_NO || DECODE(PO.BUYER, 'KRDAEW0016', '-' || TO_NUMBER(PO.LEGACY_PO_SEQ), 'KRDUPO0001', PO.LEGACY_PO_NO, '') AS REF_PR_NO , PO.DESCRIPTION , PO.SPECIFICATION , PO.UNIT_PRICE , GR.ITEM_AMT , PO.UNIT_MEASURE , PO.ITEM_QTY AS PO_ITEM_QTY , GR.ITEM_QTY AS GR_ITEM_QTY , PO.GR_QTY , GR.GR_DATE , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = PR.PURCHASER_ID) AS PO_CREATOR , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = GR.AGENT AND STATUS <> 'D') AS AGENT_NAME , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = PR.BUYER AND CODE = PR.CHANGE_USER_DEPT AND TYPE = 'C001') AS REQ_DEPT_NAME , GR.GR_SEQ , GR.PO_SEQ , GR.INV_NO , GR.INV_SEQ , DECODE(GR.INV_NO, NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS IV_EXIST , PO.BUYER , PO.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , PO.CONTRACT_NO , PO.CONTRACT_SEQ , PO.PR_NO , PH.AGENT , PR.CHANGE_USER_DEPT , GR.CLOSE_FLAG , GR.AR_BILL_FLAG , GR.AP_BILL_FLAG , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = PO.BUYER AND TYPE = 'M014' AND CODE = PO.REF_PR_NO) AS REF_PR_NO_TEXT , PR.REF_NO AS PX_NO , PO.CATEG_ID , PR.BUDGET_DEPT , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = PR.BUYER AND CODE = PR.BUDGET_DEPT AND TYPE = 'C001') AS BUDGET_DEPT_NAME , PR.ACCOUNT_TYPE , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = PR.BUYER AND TYPE = 'Z014' AND CODE = PR.ACCOUNT_TYPE) AS ACCOUNT_NAME , PR.ADD_USER_NAME , (SELECT CATEG_PATH FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = PO.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND STD_CATEG_ID = PO.CATEG_ID) AS CATEG_NAME , DECODE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = PO.BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = PO.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND SO_CA_FLAG = 'SO' AND STATUS ^='D'), 0, 'CA', 'SO') AS SO_CA_GUBUN , PR.RECV_FLAG , NVL(PO.CLSD_FLAG, 'N') AS CLSD_FLAG , PR.REF_PR_NO AS PCO_REF_PR_NO , PO.LEGACY_PO_NO AS PCO_LEGACY_PO_NO , PR.CHANGE_DATE AS PR_CHANGE_DATE , GR.ADD_USER_ID AS GR_ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = GR.ADD_USER_ID) AS GR_ADD_USER_NAME FROM ICOMPODT PO, ICOMPOHD PH, ICOMGRDT GR, ICOMPRDT PR, ICOMIVDT IV, WMSIVDT WMS WHERE GR.BUYER = #{buyer} AND GR.GR_DATE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND PR.CHANGE_USER_DEPT = #{req_dept} AND GR.AR_BILL_FLAG = #{closing_yn} AND PO.BUYER = PH.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = PH.PO_NO AND PO.BUYER = GR.BUYER AND PO.PO_NO = GR.PO_NO AND PO.PO_SEQ = GR.PO_SEQ AND PR.BUYER = PO.BUYER AND PR.PR_NO = PO.PR_NO AND PR.PR_SEQ = PO.PR_SEQ AND PO.STATUS <>'D' AND PH.STATUS <>'D' AND GR.STATUS <>'D' AND PR.STATUS <>'D' AND PO.BUYER = IV.BUYER(+) AND PO.PO_NO = IV.PO_NO(+) AND PO.PO_SEQ = IV.PO_SEQ(+) AND IV.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND IV.BUYER = WMS.BUYER(+) AND IV.INV_NO = WMS.S_INV_NO(+) AND IV.INV_SEQ = WMS.S_INV_SEQ(+) AND WMS.STATUS(+) <> 'D' ORDER BY PO.PO_NO, GR.GR_NO, GR.GR_SEQ ) S
